entities.name: Manuel Godinho de Erédia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manuel Godinho de Erédia, or Emanuel Godinho de Erédia, was a Bugis-Portuguese writer and cartographer. He wrote a number of books, including an early account of the Malay Peninsula that is a source of information on the region of that period. In the early 17th century, he became interested in exploring a "southern land", which is thought to be Australia.
